crossRefs.note: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place…
So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands…
These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
translations.bsb: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
translations.kjv: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
